lines.en: Look at this painting. How do you feel?
lines.ko: 이 그림을 봐요. 어떤 느낌이 들어요?

lines.en: I feel calm, Grandma. The scene is quiet.
Yes. The mood is soft and warm.
What is the subject of this artwork?
The subject is a mother and her child.
The background is so beautiful. I love the trees.
I felt the same when I first saw it.
lines.ko: 처음 봤을 때 저도 그렇게 느꼈어요.

lines.en: When did you buy it?
I bought it twenty years ago.
I will look at it every day now.
Excuse me. Can you help me observe this painting?
lines.ko: 실례해요. 이 그림 관찰하는 걸 도와줄 수 있어요?

lines.en: Of course. Look at the small details first.
I see a small bird in the background.
Good eye! Do you see the cat under the table?
lines.ko: 눈이 좋으시네요! 탁자 아래 고양이 보이세요?

lines.en: Oh, yes! I did not see it before now.
The artist painted it for fun long ago.
The mood feels happy. What do you think?
I feel the same. The scene is full of life.
lines.ko: 저도 그렇게 느껴요. 장면이 생기로 가득해요.

lines.en: I will come back and observe it again.
Please do. Thank you for visiting today.
lines.ko: 꼭 그러세요. 오늘 방문해 주셔서 고마워요.
